display_name: LlamaIndex (server modes: LlamaIndex Server + llama_deploy apiserver)
install_tell: Tier-A : no auth concept. LlamaIndex Server (create-llama output) exposes /api/chat with no auth, CORS allow_origins=['*'] in dev. llama_deploy apiserver app.py registers routers with CORS '*' and no auth dependency/middleware. Documented run is bare 'uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000' -> binds all interfaces. NOTE: llama_deploy is DEPRECATED ('use llama-agents'); live population may shift to LlamaAgents/llamactl whose default auth is unconfirmed.
misconfig_patterns: uvicorn --host 0.0.0.0 documented as the run command -> all-interfaces bind is the dominant misconfig
apiserver /deployments POST = unauth workflow creation/execution if write reachable
provider API keys in env, system prompts + indexed docs flow through /api/chat

active_probe.false_positive_check: apiserver: json_field max_deployments (number) + deployments (array) + status:healthy. App-server alt: GET /docs Swagger lists /api/chat AND /api/files/data, or /api/chat/config returns config JSON.

deployment_tells: 8000 LlamaIndex Server, 4501 llama_deploy apiserver control plane, 3000 Next.js create-llama front-end
Qdrant 6333/6334 most common vector store; also Weaviate 8080, Chroma
pivot_paths: GET :4501/status -> deployments array confirms platform+unauth in one read
shadow-sweep 11434 + 6333 on any IP answering on 8000
TLS SAN naming rag./chat./llama./ai. for operator attribution

CVE-2024-3271 command injection via safe_eval bypass -- library-level
